# PNX

> PNX is a free agentic SEO tool by Saboor Tahir — AI SEO audits, keyword research, SERP analysis, YouTube SEO and AI content generation. 100% free, no daily limits, no signup.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Free agentic SEO tool overview and feature grid.
- [About](/about): Founder bio (Saboor Tahir) and the mission behind PNX.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the PNX team.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about PNX, pricing, limits, and data use.
- [Blog](/blog): Free SEO guides on agentic SEO, audits, keyword research, SERP and YouTube SEO.
- [Launch PNX Chat](/chat): Free AI SEO agent — on-page audits, keyword research, SERP analysis.
- [Google OAuth & API Transparency Hub](/google-oauth-verification): Scopes, Limited Use compliance, data handling.
